name: Hillsbrad Town Registry
summary: In Hillsbrad Fields, the town hall keeps a ledger of the settlement's surviving citizens and landowners. The Hillsbrad Town Registry records civic matters, and the Forsaken seek it during their offensive against the human stronghold.

sections.title: A Record of Defiance
sections.body: The Hillsbrad Town Registry records the town's people and rights. It rests in the town hall near the podium of Magistrate Burnside. From Tarren Mill, the Forsaken press to break human resistance in the foothills. Darthalia sends Horde champions into the town hall to kill the council and seize the ledger. Its records cover Hillsbrad's population, households, and administrative rights. The registry would strip the town of its civic order and give the Undercity intelligence on the surviving population and their assets.

faq.q: Where is the Hillsbrad Town Registry kept?
faq.answer: The registry is kept in a corner of the town hall at the Hillsbrad Fields, near the stairs leading to Magistrate Burnside's platform.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want to steal it?
faq.answer: High Executor Darthalia wants to dismantle human governance in the foothills. The registry holds records of the town's citizens, households, administrative rights, and property, and would give the Forsaken intelligence on the surviving community.
Magistrate Burnside and the Hillsbrad Councilmen guard the registry. They wield defensive magic and rally inside and around the town hall.

angles.text: For the Horde, capturing the town registry helps break human authority in the foothills and secure the Forsaken stronghold at Tarren Mill.
As a human, the ledger records the formal existence and rights of Hillsbrad's remaining townsfolk. Its loss would strike the regional community hard.
